entries.verificationTarget: w200: two structurally different removeobject payloads left the entry in place; native ADT removeobject is absent on ECC 7.31 SP04
entries.notes: A real call was made and failed. The tool located the entry and passed its own pre-checks, then reported CTS_CLEANUP_POSTCHECK_ENTRY_REMAINS, and the entry is still present when E071 is read for GR2K923473 (returnedCount 25 including the target row). The PUT to /sap/bc/adt/cts/transportrequests/<task> returned 2xx and changed nothing: the request body listed tm:abap_object directly under tm:request, while the entry belongs to the task container, and SAP resolves the object against the container it is named in. The payload was corrected on 2026-09-24 to nest the objects in tm:task whenever the caller names a task that differs from the request, and that correction was then tested against w200: the PUT still returned 2xx and the entry was still present in E071, so the nesting is not proven to work. The tool is therefore best read as a platform limitation of ECC 7.31 SP04 rather than an open code defect - and it fails safely, because its own post-check refuses to report success, so no caller can be misled into believing an entry was removed. The practical remedy is to remove the entry in SE09/SE10. Nothing was released and no SAP standard object was touched. 2026-09-25 (D2 ruling, operator decision recorded in .doc/code-update-20260925-223946.md): this entry is registered platform-unsupported rather than failed. The two attempts above are the proof, not an open defect: the payload was corrected once and the second, structurally different shape removed nothing either, while the native ADT removeobject action this tool has always depended on is absent on this release.
